title: Evaluation of an endophytic symbiont as biocontrol agent against Xylella fastidiosa CoDiRO
author: M. Morelli, G. D'Attoma, M. Saponari, P. Saldarelli
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Prepare bacterial suspension
steps.instruction: Grow Paraburkholderia phytofirmans PsJN and resuspend the cells in an appropriate sterile buffer to obtain a bacterial suspension for inoculation.

steps.title: Inoculate plants by droplet puncture
steps.instruction: Using a sterile needle, apply a droplet of the P. phytofirmans suspension onto the leaf surface of olive, Nicotiana benthamiana, and oleander, then puncture the leaf to introduce the bacteria into the xylem.

steps.title: Inoculate olive plantlets by root dipping
steps.instruction: Immerse the roots of in‑vitro cultured olive plantlets in the bacterial suspension for a sufficient period to allow colonisation of the xylem vessels.

steps.title: Detect bacterial colonisation
steps.instruction: Collect plant tissue samples (e.g., leaf petioles) distal from the inoculation site and analyse them by conventional PCR, plate isolation, and the available qPCR assay specific for P. phytofirmans.
